analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 구간 진입, ADX 추세 약화
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI entering oversold, ADX trend weakening
analysis.reason: RSI 41.8로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 전 31.4에서 상승 전환. MACD 히스토그램은 -1600.8558에서 417.7217로 개선되며 바닥 다지기 신호. ADX 29.2로 뚜렷한 추세는 유지되나, 5일 전 30.1 대비 소폭 하락하며 추세 강도 약화. 5일 연속 음봉 마감 후 반등 시도하나, 20일 이동평균선(95,193원) 저항 구간에 도달하여 추가 상승 여부 확인 필요. 현재가 90,640원, 스윙 저항 95,680원, 스윙 지지 85,670원 구간에서 횡보 지속.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 41.8, up from 31.4 five days ago, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -1600.8558 to 417.7217, signaling bottoming. ADX at 29.2 indicates a clear trend, but slightly down from 30.1 five days ago, showing a slight weakening in trend strength. After five consecutive daily closes in the red, an attempt at a rebound is seen, but it has reached the resistance zone of the 20-day moving average (95,193 KRW), requiring confirmation for further upside. Current price at 90,640 KRW is consolidating between swing resistance at 95,680 KRW and swing support at 85,670 KRW.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (90,640 KRW) vs SMA5 (90,847 KRW) / SMA20 (95,193 KRW) / SMA50 (102,655 KRW): diagnosed below short-term, mid-term, and long-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 (110,242 KRW) / SMA200 (100,070 KRW): diagnosed below mid-to-long-term trend, in a weak zone.
· 52-week position (49.2%) + current price level at a historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (31.4→41.8) + exiting oversold territory + signaling a potential upward reversal.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1600.8558→417.7217) + diagnosed as improving + signaling bottoming action.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 95,193 KRW) + interpreted band width at 37.64% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line (85,670 KRW) + based on Pivot S1 (78,385 KRW).
· Swing resistance line (95,680 KRW) + aligned with the 20-day moving average (95,193 KRW).
· 5-day / 20-day high-low pattern (Higher Low) + signaling recovery.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.05x) + indicating normal activity levels.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + confirmation of conditions for waiting.
